visual_tone_principle.description: Use font='draw' for a friendly look. Clean lines, consistent shapes.

hierarchy_principle.description: Within a color family: Sig 3 -> fill: solid (Darker/Richer). Sig 2 -> fill: semi (Lighter). Sig 1 -> fill: none. Avoid changing the hue.

color_principle.description: CRITICAL: If Group 'Risks' is Red, all nodes inside MUST be Red. Use fill opacity to distinguish items, NOT color. Maintain high text contrast.

shape_principle.description: Force 'rectangle' for all UML classes to ensure alignment. Uniform width.

connection_principle.description: Use black or grey arrows. Keep them simple.

detailed_comments.Source_A_StylingDesignAgent_generated: No explicit groups in topology; treat entire diagram as single monochromatic family. Assign blue palette to all classes: Account (solid), AddressBook (semi), Contact (none), ContactGroup (semi). Use white text on solid fills, black elsewhere. Arrows black.
